periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at approximately a 45-degree downward angle toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-shaped with vertical elongation; width is significantly less than height.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lower edge extending toward the cheek/snout region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior profile across the shoulder region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible lateral torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, approximately 2.5 times the horizontal width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the top of the ear pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Pink tissue/tongue tip visible at the lower portion of the muzzle.
